name: Brimstone Flames
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (pinch of brimstone)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

You cause the target to be engulfed in sulfurous flames.

The target takes 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) and are sickened for 2d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the sickening.
